title: Zesty Turkish Lamb Kofte
description: Winey, crunchy lamb kofte cooked in a kazan cauldron, finished with bird's eye chillies and fresh herbs for a bright, light Turkish dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix ground lamb, panko, cooked rice, minced onion, minced garlic, chopped bird's eye chili, dried oregano, ground cumin, salt, pepper, and beaten egg until just combined.
Fold in chopped parsley and mint and form the mixture into bite‑size kofte shaped into small balls.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a kazan cauldron over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the lamb kofte to the pot and brown on all sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Pour 30 ml white wine over the browned kofte and let reduce for 1 minute, stirring gently.
Add 500 ml water, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 70°C, about 7 minutes.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking and ensure even cooking.
Remove the pot from heat and let the kofte rest for 5 minutes before transferring to a serving platter.
Garnish with additional parsley, mint, and a squeeze of lemon juice for brightness.
Serve the warm, crunchy lamb kofte hot from the kazan with a side of plain yogurt or a fresh cucumber salad.
